title: Cloud Sales Consultant – AWS
description:
We’re Hiring: Cloud Sales Consultant – AWS
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana
 



**Workplace:** 
 On\-site
 



**Employment:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 0–2 Years
 



**Preferred Background:** 
 Engineering / Technology degree; MBA preferred
 



  





 About Technum Opus
 



**Technum Opus Pvt. Ltd.** 
 is an AWS Partner working with businesses on cloud adoption, migration, optimization and digital transformation initiatives.
 



 We are looking for a
 **Cloud Sales Executive** 
 who can engage confidently with prospective customers, understand their business and technology requirements, and take ownership of opportunities from the initial conversation through discovery, follow\-up, proposal and closure.
 



 This is
 **not a telecalling role** 
 . We are looking for someone who enjoys meeting and speaking with customers, understands consultative B2B selling, and can develop enough understanding of a customer's technology environment to have a meaningful cloud conversation.
 



  





 What You’ll Do
 


* Engage with prospective customers and conduct
 **discovery calls and meetings**
* **Understand the customer's existing IT/cloud environment, business requirements, challenges and planned initiatives**
* **Identify opportunities where AWS cloud services and Technum Opus solutions** 
 can address customer requirements
* Qualify opportunities and determine the appropriate next steps
* Present and communicate our cloud offerings clearly to business and technical stakeholders
* Coordinate with our cloud/technical team where deeper solutioning or architecture discussions are required
* Prepare and coordinate proposals, commercials, presentations and other sales material
* Maintain consistent and tactful follow\-up with prospects and keep opportunities moving forward
* Handle customer questions, objections and commercial discussions appropriately
* Build relationships with decision\-makers and other stakeholders within prospective customer organizations
* Maintain accurate opportunity information and next actions in the CRM
* Work closely with leadership and technical teams to
 **progress and close opportunities**
* **Attend in\-person customer meetings** 
 in Gurugram/Delhi NCR and travel for customer meetings when required



 What We’re Looking For
 


* **0–2 years of experience** 
 in B2B sales, technology sales, cloud sales, SaaS sales, IT services or a related customer\-facing role
* Working knowledge of
 **AWS Cloud and commonly used AWS services**
* **Ability to understand a customer's requirement and connect it with an appropriate technology solution**
* **Strong spoken and written communication skills**
* **Confident, tactful and professional in dealing with prospective customers**
* **Comfortable conducting discovery conversations with business and technical stakeholders**
* **Strong follow\-up, negotiation and relationship\-management skills**
* **Commercial mindset with the ability and willingness to take ownership of opportunities through closure**
* **Comfortable meeting customers in person and travelling when business requirements demand it**
* **Self\-driven, organized and comfortable working with targets and sales pipelines**



 AWS Knowledge
 



 We do not expect the candidate to be a cloud architect. However, the candidate should have a practical understanding of cloud concepts and commonly used AWS services such as
 **EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, CloudFront and AWS cost/pricing fundamentals** 
 .
 



 The candidate should be comfortable having an initial cloud discussion with a prospect and know when to involve the technical team for deeper architecture and solutioning.
 



**AWS certifications or prior experience selling AWS/cloud solutions will be an advantage.** 




  





 Who Should Apply?
 



 This role would suit someone who:
 


* Enjoys
 **talking to customers and building relationships**
* **Can ask the right questions instead of simply delivering a sales pitch**
* **Is persistent with follow\-ups without being overly aggressive**
* **Is comfortable discussing both business requirements and technology**
* **Wants to build a long\-term career in AWS cloud sales and enterprise technology sales**
* **Likes the challenge of taking an opportunity from “interested” to “closed”**



 If this sounds like you, apply through LinkedIn or share your CV/profile along with a short note explaining your experience with
 **B2B sales, AWS or cloud technologies** 
 .

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Industry Solutions
description:
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the \#1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.
   

  

 To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.
   

  

 As a Forward Deployed Engineer in our Industry ISV Practice, you will work directly with independent software vendors (ISVs) and their engineering organizations to build MongoDB capabilities into their products. You will work in the partner’s codebase, languages, engineering practices, and release process to deliver production\-ready integrations, migrations, and product capabilities. The solutions you help build should leave the partner with maintainable code and knowledge, while creating reusable patterns that can accelerate future partner engagements.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on application engineering role. You will spend time understanding existing products built on relational databases, designing practical MongoDB approaches, writing production code, and working alongside partner engineers through implementation and rollout. The role requires regular travel and time on\-site with ISV partners during key phases of the engagement.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 What you’ll do at MongoDB
   

  

 In this role, you will
   

  

* Embed with ISV engineering teams, adapting to their codebase, practices, release cadence, and constraints while understanding their product architecture, industry context, data model, and deployment environment
* Design and build MongoDB\-backed product capabilities, including integrations, data models, indexes, queries, persistence layers, migration tooling, and support for MongoDB alongside relational database editions
* Design and implement coexistence and migration solutions, including synchronization, change data capture (CDC), dual writes, consistency, application refactoring, validation, and controlled cutover
* Design and validate production\-ready solutions for performance, scalability, resilience, observability, security, and operational readiness across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes\-based private clouds, and self\-managed or restricted on\-premises environments
* Enable partner engineers through collaborative development, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing, while working with internal technical teams to resolve design questions and establish support boundaries
* Capture reusable implementation patterns, tooling, product gaps, and lessons learned to accelerate future partner engagements


 As an ideal candidate, you will have
   

  

* 5\+ years of hands\-on backend engineering experience building and operating production applications
* Strong application\-side expertise with MongoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, and a clear understanding of query and transaction semantics
* Application\-level fluency with at least one major relational database, including relational data modeling, access patterns, database drivers or ORMs, indexing, transactions, query planning, and transaction\-isolation assumptions
* Experience integrating a new database into a large production codebase and migrating production workloads, including persistence abstractions, data synchronization, dual\-write or CDC patterns, application refactoring, validation, and incremental rollout
* Strong coding ability in at least two languages such as Java, C\#/.NET, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or Go, plus experience with APIs, distributed systems, containers, and cloud or self\-managed deployment environments
* Experience with SaaS and product engineering, including multi\-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, and backward compatibility, together with the ability to work effectively in unfamiliar codebases and explain technical trade\-offs clearly
* Willingness to spend significant time on\-site with ISV partners and travel within the region


 As an ideal candidate, you may also have
   

  

* Experience working for or with an ISV, or in a forward\-deployed, embedded, resident\-engineer, or partner\-engineering role
* Familiarity with event\-driven and microservices architectures and technologies such as Kafka, as well as performance engineering, observability, resilience, or production\-readiness reviews
* Exposure to security and compliance requirements for ISVs serving regulated industries
* Experience creating reusable tooling, reference implementations, integration components, or technical documentation, along with MongoDB certification, Atlas experience, or familiarity with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio


 What you will learn
   

  

* Gain practical experience modernizing applications and delivering MongoDB solutions for partner products across different industries, including coexistence and migration scenarios in cloud\-native environments, while developing reusable patterns and your technical and communication skills
* Broaden your perspective on how data\-intensive products evolve and develop the judgment to translate diverse product and operational requirements into practical MongoDB solutions


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI\-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
   

  

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
   

  

 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

The organization is driven by the vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat and large\-scale digital transformation in India and beyond.
 



  





***Immediate Joiners preferred.***




  





**About the Role.** 




 We're looking for a hands\-on private\-cloud engineer who can take an OpenStack\-based platform from bare metal to a working, accepted, and supportable production environment — and then own it through its operational lifecycle.
 



 This is a greenfield deployment covering compute, software\-defined storage, GPU enablement, Kubernetes, and an AI/ML platform. You'll lead or contribute to technical delivery, automation, capacity growth, operational improvement, resilience testing, documentation, and training of the internal cloud team.
 



 This is not a role for someone who has only consumed OpenStack through a dashboard. We need someone who has deployed it, broken it, recovered it, automated it, and documented it — using Kolla Ansible as the deployment tooling.
 



 The role combines architecture input with hands\-on engineering. You won't be expected to single\-handedly deliver every specialist subsystem without support, but you must understand the full platform and be able to troubleshoot across its major layers.
 



  





**What You will do.** 




 Deployment \& Architecture
 


* Design and deploy a multi\-node OpenStack private cloud using Kolla Ansible
* Configure a highly available control plane and define service placement, failure domains, and network segmentation (management, API, provider, tenant, external)
* Deploy and configure core services: Keystone, Nova, Placement, Glance, Neutron, Cinder, Horizon
* Maintain version\-controlled inventory, configuration, and secrets\-management procedures
* Produce architecture documents, capacity plans, and implementation runbooks



 Storage
 


* Design and deploy a distributed software\-defined storage platform (Ceph preferred) as the shared substrate
* Integrate block/image storage with Glance, Cinder, and Nova; stand up an S3\-compatible object endpoint
* Define replication/erasure\-coding policies, failure domains, and capacity thresholds
* Validate failure, degraded\-mode, and recovery behaviour



 Networking \& Security
 


* Design and configure management, API, provider, tenant, storage, and tunnel networks
* Implement VLANs, overlays, routing, firewalling, and security groups per the organisation's addressing standards
* Apply security\-hardening baselines and maintain compliance evidence



 Compute \& Workloads
 


* Build and maintain golden images and flavour catalogues (CPU, memory, NUMA, huge pages, GPU profiles)
* Configure host aggregates, availability zones, and placement/scheduling policies
* Restore and re\-platform existing Windows and Linux workloads into the new environment



 GPU Enablement
 


* Enable GPU access end\-to\-end: firmware, BIOS, IOMMU, kernel parameters, drivers, device binding
* Configure PCI passthrough or vGPU as required; configure Nova PCI aliases, traits, and scheduler filters
* Expose GPU resources to Kubernetes worker nodes via appropriate device plugins



 Kubernetes \& AI/ML Platform
 


* Deploy and operate a highly available Kubernetes cluster on the private cloud
* Configure CNI, ingress, RBAC, CSI\-backed persistent storage, and GPU\-schedulable nodes
* Deploy an approved AI/ML workspace platform (notebooks, training jobs, model serving) with per\-project isolation and quotas



 Identity \& Enterprise Integration
 


* Integrate with the organisation's enterprise directory; configure SSO/federation across OpenStack, Kubernetes, and the AI workspace
* Implement role mapping, least\-privilege access, and credential\-rotation procedures



 Monitoring, Logging \& Audit
 


* Implement monitoring/alerting across hosts, OpenStack services, storage, VMs, Kubernetes, and GPU utilisation

****About The Role****
 We’re hiring Solution Architects to help the world’s best engineering organizations figure out what AI\-native software development actually looks like in production.

 Solution Architects sit at the center of long\-term customer transformation. You’ll help customers move from initial excitement to deeply integrating engineering workflows that teams rely on every day. That means understanding how modern software organizations operate, identifying where Cursor can create the most leverage, and helping customers scale adoption across teams, platforms, and workflows over time.

You’ll configure environments, design workflows, run enablement sessions, and solve technical problems directly with developers and platform teams inside complex enterprise environments. You’ll also help engineering leaders think through rollout strategy, workflow evolution, and the long\-term architecture for AI\-native development.

* Configure environments, design workflows, and run hands\-on enablement sessions

* Drive fast time\-to\-value and durable adoption across teams
* Identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly


**Expand Cursor Across the Organization**

* Help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company\-wide adoption
* Design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups
* Partner with customers to operationalize AI\-assisted development at scale
* Work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments


**Become a Trusted Technical Partner**
* Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders
* Lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions
* Advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy
* Coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress
* Help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI\-native development evolves


**Drive Real Customer Outcomes**
* Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact
* Connect Cursor usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality
* Help customers communicate the value of Cursor internally and build momentum for broader adoption
* Turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization


**Help Make Cursor Indispensable**

* Monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on Cursor over time
* Support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction
* Help customers build workflows they can’t imagine operating without


**Shape the Future of the Product**

* Identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements
* Help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships
* Turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns

* You have a strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments
* You have excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences
* You have strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams
* You have high ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast\-moving environments with ambiguity
* You have a passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering
* You are willing to travel to customers needed

title: Senior Support Engineer
description:
**Role Summary:** 




 The Senior Support Engineer \- Systems, is a highly skilled technical professional responsible for supporting and managing Windows technologies, Azure, O365, and virtualization platforms. This role involves troubleshooting and optimizing enterprise systems, ensuring high availability, and delivering efficient IT service solutions. The Senior Support Engineer will be the go\-to expert for resolving complex technical issues, administering cloud services like Azure, managing O365 environments, and providing support for virtualized infrastructure (VMware/Hyper\-V).In this role, you will oversee day\-to\-day system operations, provide escalated support, and ensure the performance and security of Windows\-based systems, cloud resources, and virtualized environments. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to the optimization of IT services while maintaining a focus on scalability, performance, and security.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 Windows Technologies Support:
 



 \- Provide advanced support and troubleshooting for Windows Server environments (Windows Server 2016/2019/2022\).
 



 \- Manage Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP services.
 



 \- Administer and troubleshoot issues related to file systems, print servers, Windows networking, and system security.
 



  





 Azure Support \& Management:
 



 \- Provide support for Azure cloud infrastructure, including resource provisioning, network configuration, and security management.
 



 \- Administer and troubleshoot Azure Active Directory, Virtual Machines (VMs), Storage accounts, Azure Backup, and Azure Site Recovery.
 



 \- Assist with cloud migration and integration strategies, ensuring optimal cloud performance and cost\-efficiency.
 



  





 O365 Administration:
 



 \- Manage and support O365 services including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, and Teams.
 



 \- Handle user provisioning, mailbox management, and security configurations for O365 environments.
 



 \- Troubleshoot issues related to email flow, collaboration tools, and cloud\-based productivity solutions.
 



  





 Virtualization Support:
 



 \- Support virtualization technologies such as VMware vSphere, Nutanix and Microsoft Hyper\-V.
 



 \- Manage virtual machines, hosts, and clusters, ensuring high availability, performance, and efficient resource allocation.
 



 \- Implement and troubleshoot VM snapshots, templates, and resource pools.
 



  





 Incident \& Problem Management:
 



 \- Handle escalated support tickets, providing resolution to complex issues in a timely manner.
 



 \- Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to resolve system issues, focusing on root cause analysis and preventive measures.
 



 \- Monitor system health and proactively address potential system failures or performance degradation.
 



  





 System Performance \& Optimization:
 



 \- Monitor the performance and health of Windows, Azure, O365, and virtualized systems.
 



 \- Optimize system configurations to improve performance, scalability, and availability.
 



 \- Perform system tuning, backup verification, and disaster recovery testing.
 



  





 Documentation \& Reporting:
 



 \- Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, troubleshooting steps, and known issues.
 



 \- Generate regular reports on system performance, service requests, and support tickets.
 



 \- Document processes for knowledge sharing and team reference.
 



  





 Security \& Compliance:
 



 \- Ensure systems comply with security best practices, applying security patches and updates.
 



 \- Configure and manage firewalls, antivirus, and other security measures to protect systems.
 



 \- Assist with security audits and ensure compliance with internal security policies and industry standards.
 



  





 Team Collaboration \& Knowledge Sharing:
 



 \- Collaborate with other engineers, network teams, and IT staff to provide integrated IT solutions.
 



 \- Mentor and train junior support engineers, sharing knowledge and best practices.
 



 \- Participate in internal knowledge\-sharing sessions and provide expertise on complex system issues.
 



  





**Functional/Technical Competencies:** 




 \- Strong proficiency in Windows Server environments (2016, 2019, 2022\).
 



  





 \- Experience with Azure Active Directory, Azure virtual machines, and Azure Backup.
 



  





 \- In\-depth knowledge of O365 services such as Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive for Business.
 



  





 \- Expertise in VMware, Nutanix and Hyper\-V virtualization platforms, including troubleshooting and performance tuning.
 



  





 \- Knowledge of PowerShell scripting for automation of routine administrative tasks.
 



  





**Education:** 




 \- Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
 



  





**Experience:** 




 \- 7\-10 years of hands\-on experience supporting and managing Windows technologies (Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, etc.).

 \- Strong background in virtualization technologies, such as VMware, Nutanix and Hyper\-V.
